test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: By selling an item for ₹2,332, a person incurred a loss of 12%. What was the cost price of the item?
solution:
Given:

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 2332

Loss % = 12%

Formula used:

SP = CP(1 - Loss/100)

Where, CP = Cost Price, SP = Selling Price

Calculations:

⇒ 2332 = CP × (1 - 12/100)

⇒ 2332 = CP × (1 - 0.12)

⇒ 2332/0.88 = CP

⇒ CP = Rs. 2650

∴ The cost price of an item is Rs. 2650.
